site_schedule: Separate synchronized-start replays. Decision clock is elapsed minutes. No site or device identifier selects the tool. Strictly earlier failures only.
feedback: Five evenly spaced available records of each completed reference device; rounded linspace in chronological order; each unit has equal weight. Service devices never become feedback.
criterion: Choose the tool with lowest mean per-device mean squared error over all released reference devices. Ties in listed order. Also issue an arm freezing the first such decision, every fixed tool and the original package.
femto: Learning_set six reference devices, Full_Test_Set eleven service devices. New original snapshots 48,108,... before failure. If retrieval fails, predetermined local offset 40 reported separately as a replay.
xjtu: Official validation fourth devices are feedback only; three fifth devices are service. New original snapshots 6,16,... before failure. If mirror unavailable use old fifth-devices manifest as a labeled replay. Additionally evaluate previously unscored local Bearing1_5 offset 6 independently when remote fails.
score: Primary pooled snapshot RMSE in minutes, also each device and worst-device RMSE. Resource limit zero retraining, zero service labels. Record lower budget used by fixed arms.
accept: Adopt automatic choice only if primary RMSE beats every fixed tool and choose-once by at least one percent on both sites, with worst-device RMSE no more than one percent higher than the best-primary fixed tool on either site. Otherwise keep selector experimental. Do not pick a new universal default using these test scores.
